mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, significantly reducing amiodarone plasma concentrations and its antiarrhythmic efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, increase amiodarone dose and monitor QTc interval, amiodarone levels, and arrhythmia control closely, as rifampin may reduce amiodarone effectiveness to subtherapeutic levels.
